records.indication: acute pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic in adults in certified medically supervised settings
records.notes: AcelRx publicly stated PDUFA 2018-11-03 in its May 24 2018 issuer press release. Original FDA retrospective statistical review specifies internal goal 2018-11-02, and FDA approved November 2, one day before publicly announced target. Keep first-public target and retrospective internal goal as two independent fields. Original application received October 2017 CRL; May 3 2018 complete Class 2 resubmission, separate cycle. Phase 3 SAP303 top-line Sept 15 2016 and SAP302 NCT02447848. 2018 Q1/Q2 10-Q cover shares jumped from 51,320,598 to 60,599,914; cap must use dated publicly available share facts and be independently audited for offerings, splits and liquidity. No approved 10-year trading event or RAAS metric.
